headline: Every vegetable pack checked, not a sample.
label: #FFF8EC
visitLine: Call and visit to Werribee South
heroLede: With different vegetables and pack sizes going out to wholesale and retail, every pack needs the right label and date. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is sealed flat across, with no leaf or stem caught in the seal. A weak seal shortens shelf life and turns into a complaint.
labelLede: Packs of broccoli and cauliflower can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for what is inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: Every pack needs a correct, readable best-before date. The system reads the printed date and batch code on every pack and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Soil, leaves, rubber bands and packaging offcuts can all end up on the conveyor. The camera spots anything that should not be there before packs reach a crate.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes. Check the bagger.
